headline: Kingsoft Cloud Reports Unaudited Third Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Chinese cloud provider Kingsoft Cloud Holdings released its unaudited financial performance for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
why: Kingsoft Cloud is a major provider of cloud infrastructure services in China listed on both NASDAQ and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
